Enemies frozen by <stasis/>Winter's Wrath receive 150% increased <stasis/>Shatter damage.

Upon performing <stasis/>Winter's Wrath's heavy attack:
• Allies within 30 meters receive the maximum <stasis/>Frost Armor Stacks and 4 Stacks of <stasis/>Stasis Weapon Surge for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds
• Refunds ?% Super Energy per ally buffed. (Only works once per ally?)

Grants maximum <stasis/>Frost Armor Stacks to you once <stasis/>Winter's Wrath ends.

On Rift Cast with the <stasis/>Frostpulse Aspect equipped:
• You and allies within ? meters receive 2 Stacks of <stasis/>Stasis Weapon Surge for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds alongside maximum <stasis/>Frost Armor Stacks
• Grants 2% <stasis/>Winter's Wrath Super Energy for each ally that received the above benefits
